deprecation.message: This version was signed with (or depends on packages signed with) a code-signing certificate that has since been revoked, so NuGet restore can fail with NU3012. Use 12.1.1, which is re-signed with a valid certificate and references re-signed dependencies.

releaseNotes: Compatibility shim for one-time V10 to V11 database migration. New applications should use Akavache.Sqlite3 directly.
